# New Leaf Hearing Care

> Audiology and hearing aid clinic serving Arvada and Littleton, Colorado. Hearing
> assessments, hearing aids and fittings, ear wax removal, tinnitus evaluation and
> management, custom earmolds and auditory training.

Site: https://newleafhearing.com

## Services

- [Audiology services](https://newleafhearing.com/audiology-services/)
- [Hearing assessments](https://newleafhearing.com/audiology-services/hearing-assessments/)
- [Ear wax removal](https://newleafhearing.com/audiology-services/ear-wax-removal/)
- [Tinnitus evaluation and management](https://newleafhearing.com/audiology-services/tinnitus-evaluation-management/)
- [Custom earmolds](https://newleafhearing.com/audiology-services/custom-earmolds/)
- [Communication training program](https://newleafhearing.com/audiology-services/communication-training-program/)
- [LACE AI Pro auditory training](https://newleafhearing.com/audiology-services/lace-ai-pro-auditory-training/)
- [Hearing aid services](https://newleafhearing.com/hearing-aid-services/)
- [Hearing aid fittings](https://newleafhearing.com/hearing-aids-products/hearing-aid-fittings/)
- [Hearing aid repairs and maintenance](https://newleafhearing.com/hearing-aids-products/hearing-aid-repairs-maintenance/)
